svg.title: Apply this first to the direct coefficient with C = Tm,ε, then to its difference from the iterated P v̸=root qDv+1 coefficient with C = Tm,ε . The iterated coefficient is integrable because it is the v difference of those two integrable quantities. Subtracting their integrals proves the weighted version of (NE2). No product structure or absolute continuity assumption on μ is used.
